subject: financial_literacy
concept: Applying banking, interest, account tracking, and borrowing concepts to a real-world scenario using the student's interest profile
source_inspiration: original content — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student manages a simple simulated bank account across several deposits, withdrawals, and a small amount of interest
exercise.pictorial: Student illustrates their account activity on a simple register
exercise.abstract: Student explains the final balance and how it changed over the scenario

assessment.mastery_threshold: final balance is calculated correctly based on all transactions
misconception_flags: miscalculates the running balance at any point in the sequence of transactions

interest_binding: scenario generated fresh from student's stated interest profile
